query:
UPDATE kennels
                SET 
                command = $2,
                guild_id = $3,
                role_id = $4,
                msg_announce = $5,
                msg_announce_edit = $6,
                msg_release = $7,
                kennel_channel_id = $8,
                kennel_msg = $9,
                kennel_msg_edit = $10,
                kennel_release_msg = $11,
                opt_in_to_metrics = $12
            WHERE
                id = $1
                ;
